integrity: A complete analytic proof and an exact rational interval certificate are included. Numerical locations are illustrative. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit graph-metric edges and positive variable heat conductances; the migration formula assumes b>2a>0 and c>3(b-a); the two-peak example uses exactly (1,3,9). No larger-graph extension or general weighted-metric assertion. Unindexed equivalent prior work is possible.
title: A unique heat-gradient migration and two transient amplification peaks on a weighted four-vertex path
